relationships.subject: Nauclea diderrichii extracts
relationships.evidence_quote: the aqueous and ethanolic extracts of Nauclea diderrichii significantly (p < 0.001) inhibited castor oil-induced secretory diarrhea at all the doses

relationships.subject: misoprostol
relationships.evidence_quote: Misoprostol is a synthetic analogue of PGE2 which generates an accumulation of intestinal fluid and stimulates the secretion of mucus

relationships.subject: glibenclamide
relationships.evidence_quote: The pretreatment of rats with glibenclamide significantly (p < 0.001) decreases antidiarrheal activity of the aqueous extract of Nauclea diderrichii (300 mg/kg).

key_findings: Nauclea diderrichii extracts reduced castor oil diarrhea and misoprostol fluid accumulation and intestinal motility; glibenclamide but not yohimbine blunted the effect
